BETWEEN:-
 AKASH KUSHWAH S/O VISHAMBHAR DAYAL  KUSHWAH, AGE-25 YEARS, OCCUPATION-STUDENT, R/O  PURANI MANDI KE PAS, GOPALPURA, SHAMSHABAD,
 AGRA (UTTAR PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI ATUL GUPTA - ADVOCATE FOR THE APPLICANT)
 AND  STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION CRIME BRANCH, DISTRICT GWALIOR  (MADHYA PRADESH)

 (SHRI R.K. AWASTHY - PUBLIC PROSECUTOR FOR RESPONDENT/STATE)

This application coming on for hearing this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
This is second repeat application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of regular bail.
His first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 06.06.2022 in M.Cr.C. No.26609 of 2022.

The applicant is in custody since 09.04.2022 in connection with Crime No.23/2022 registered at Police Station Crime Branch, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 419,
420, 34 of IPC and Section 66- D of IT Act and added Sections 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Crime Branch, District Gwalior
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, the applicant and other co-accused persons are involved in overseas fraudulent dealings through call centers.

Styling themselves as agent of one lending Club Finance Company, they made calls to residents of United States of America as if there were the local agents alluring them with the offer of loan of 10000-20000 dollars and in that practice used to obtain their Akash Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140869288/
1 social security numbers and other bank details.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: To reinforce confidence some partial amount used to be deposited in their account.
Forged documents were also prepared and passed on to them camouflaging as loan documents.
Thereafter, misusing their social security numbers and bank details, they used to withdraw the amount from their accounts.
On the basis of the aforesaid, crime has been registered.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
He has no criminal antecedents.
Due to financial crises, he was forced to apply for a job.
He was not aware of the vulnerable activities of the said call center where he applied.
Neither he owned the laptop nor any other incriminating material.
In fact the laptop and computers belong to main accused Balram Prajapati.
He was manipulated by him with the salary of Rs.10000-20000 to get trained and involved in the unethical and fraudulent act of cheating and forgery.
Taking advantage of his helplessness and need of money, he laid the trap whereupon he has fallen.
Instant case is that of big scam of fraudulent activities of call center.

It is further submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that co-accused, namely, Monika Dixit has already been extended the benefit of regular bail vide order dated 25.01.2023 in M.Cr.C. No.2550 of 2023 and case of the present applicant is akin to that of the co- accused Monika Dixit.
The applicant is the resident of Agra (Uttar Pradesh).
His case is different from that of rest of the accused person.
He shall abide all the terms and conditions this court deems fit and proper.
On such grounds, prayer for grant of bail is made.

P e r contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application supporting the order impugned with submission that regard being had to the disclosure of the fact by the applicant in his 27 Evidence Act memo and seizure made i.e. laptop and other incriminating information contained therein, no exception can be taken in the matter of enlargement of bail.

U p o n hearing learned counsel for the rival parties but without commenting upon the rival contentions touching merits of the case, regard being had to the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents, has undergone incarceration of one year and the co-accused, namely, Monika Dixit has already been extended the benefit of regular bail vide order dated 25.01.2023 in M.Cr.C.
No.2550 of 2023, the present applicant is held entitled for enlargement on bail but with stringent conditions.
Consequently, the application of the applicant filed under Section 439 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 is hereby allowed.

( iii) the concerned Jail Authorities are directed that before releasing the applicant,
the medical examination of the applicant be conducted through the jail doctor and if it is prima facie found that he is having any symptoms of COVID-19, then the consequential follow up action or any further test required, be undertaken immediately.

If not, the applicant shall be released on bail in terms of the conditions imposed in this order;
(iv) on violation of conditions, State is free to apply for cancellation of bail.

(v) in future, if the applicant is found to be involved in such nature of cases or any other similar criminal cases or misuses the bail granted by this Court, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically.
Learned Public Prosecutor is directed to send an e-copy of this order to all the concerned including the concerned Station House Officer of the Police Station for information and necessary action.
Certified copy as per rules.
